details.note: I used the w17->w18 change mask as the pane mask. PY/Y panes went from p50 ~233/239/243 (0% near-white, min channel >= 245) to ~247/249/253, now 64-91% near-white: s08 90.8%, q16 79.1%, q14 69.0%, ra_pyWin 65.2%, q17 65.3%, ra_yWin 63.8%, s02 63.6%. Under the photos: y_47300 panes p50 249/250/250 with 59% near-white; c_27316 pane core p50 255 with 90% near-white, 89% >= 250. The panes now sit 35-40 levels above the lining ring beside them (ring p50 ~202-217), as in c_27316, where the pane is 255 and the lining 196-233. Before the change they sat only ~25 levels above it, at G<=242. The residual differences are small. The panes stay slightly cool (R-B ~ -6, while the photo is neutral, at 255/255/255), and they only rarely reach 250 in all channels (0.1-16% vs the photo's 40-89%). They are not blown or flat: pane L std rose slightly (s08 3.9->4.7, ra_yWin 5.7->6.4), so faint cloud texture survives, and the crops still read as glass. F/J panes are less white (q03 24.6% near-white, b_jClose 22.8%, s09 40.9%) because those views look out at sky. That is correct.

No regression. In q12, the pane region (38% of the frame) brightened by about +8 (p50 155/169/187 -> 164/176/195), and cloud highlights went from max 230 to 236. Contrast held (L std 33.6 -> 34.8), the sky stays deep blue at the top, and the wing reads crisper and less grey through the glass. Through the ra_jWin panes the sky is still blue and the nacelle shading is intact (p50 195/212/229 -> 213/225/241). The q07 near pane shows blue sky (p50 229/232/241, 0% near-white), whereas c_27316 is blown to 255. That is exposure and sky (lighting area), not pane tint.
Unchanged: clean seams, plain satin, no weave.
Geometry unchanged. The whiter pane improves the pane-vs-bezel value step. The PY/Y tub-floor card remains.

notes: I rated from the supplied renders only (no browser). The w17->w18 diffs (scripts scratchpad/w18b/diff.py and pane.py) touch only glass pixels. q15, s05 and ra_door2floor are pixel-identical, and every changed pixel brightened, by a mean of about +11/+9/+9 over its area, slightly more in red, so the cool cast dropped. There are no changes outside the panes and no regressions anywhere. q12 is slightly better: less grey veil, contrast kept. The target is met: day panes are near-white, above the lining, like c_27316 / y_47300, and they keep faint cloud texture. That is one fix among many minor items, and the carried low-severity issues hold the area at 8.5, so I have not raised the score. Lighting note (not scored): the q07 near pane shows a saturated blue sky where c_27316 is blown white, which is an exposure/sky matter.
